The evidence path for the related episode also points to a different session directory (`seed-r0-muninn-why-gin`) than this checkout (`cell-r0-revoke-compression-muninn-why/gin`). So the "trust 2 / commit-linked" record doesn't correspond to this project's actual history — I treated it as not applicable rather than inventing a value from it, per your instruction not to invent a value.
